runs.methodDetail: Heat pretreatment: 95°C for 3 minutes in 0.5% Triton X-100, followed by dilution. Final vaccine dilution 1:50 and gBlock dilution 1:20,000 of each target. Both were added at 2 µl per 20 µl reaction, with 1 µl reverse-primer mix (operator confirmed). The final Triton concentration for this Bio-Rad preparation was not separately recorded. Export name specifies 30-second extension; exported melt scan spans 68–95°C at 0.5°C intervals. Rows A/B/C contain Spike/Ori/mixed gBlocks; E/F/G contain the corresponding vaccine reactions; column 12 is NTC.
runs.resultNote: At the default threshold, single-target estimates rise with length and receive no physical Poisson correction. In the mixed-target row, the longest Cy5 gBlock controls cross earlier than their single-target counterparts; the positive fitted Spike decay therefore also reflects control behavior. Inspect C10/C11 versus A10/A11 before interpreting that fit as fragmentation. No additional exclusions have been applied.
